prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 28 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1307; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision during a lane change, reporting neck pain and stiffness. Examination revealed reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness, consistent with a cervical strain; the mechanism described is a plausible cause of this type of injury. Neurological screening, including reflexes and sensation in the upper extremities, was within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment involving the cervical spine is known to this provider. Care consisted of 28 visits combining manual therapy, stretching, and a home exercise program, following a typical course for this presentation. Symptoms improved steadily, and visit frequency was reduced accordingly as function returned. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicated or repeated entries. Patient is discharged to self-directed exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
